# Corpus files that fail an OTF rule today, and the rule ids each breaks.
# Ratchet (tests/test_otf_schema.py): a file not listed here must pass; a listed
# file whose rule ids change fails the test, and so does a listed sources/ file
# that starts passing (a fixed or deleted works/ file does not: readers edit
# works/ on main, and that must not block a deploy). Rule ids are
# the [bracketed] ids from otf_schema.py; `schema` means the JSON Schema rejects it.
# Format: <path> <rule-id> [<rule-id> ...]
